links.outcome: Discrimination (AUC) of LLMs versus AHI rule and structured/TF-IDF baselines for MoCA<26
links.effect: AHI rule AUC 0.456; age-and-education model 0.759; GPT-5.2 0.698 (98.6% sensitivity, 47.4% specificity); Gemini 3 Pro 0.884, exceeding baselines after Holm correction.
links.quote: Gemini 3 Pro achieved the highest discrimination (AUC 0.884, 95% CI 0.822-0.934), exceeding the age-and-education model, the full structured model, the gradient-boosted structured model, and the input-matched TF-IDF model after Holm correction within their respective comparison families.

screen.reason: Retrospective evaluation of LLMs and machine learning models for predicting cognitive impairment risk from clinical/imaging reports without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
